arutpa:T160:62: Though infinite Vedas sought and measured for countless ages, scanning with thousands upon thousands of faces, they failed to find even an atom's measure; then weeping, crying 'Siva, Siva', longing and turning back, O Siva living in the grace-filled supreme space, like a mother who gives birth, yearns, and nurtures with tender grace, you are the God who ever supports and protects those like us.
arutpa:T158:117: So that the universal worlds may live, so that we may live, so that the four Vedas—your own word—may live—
arutpa:T291:6: O Lord, you must hear my plea and grant it: all the macrocosm and microcosm must be perceived, all worlds with drums, all gods, and all lives must attain the pure Siva Sanmarga, and I must perform the five acts beginning with creation, even the five acts of creation and knowledge. In the unbroken sacred form, may my mother and I become one and thrive forever.
arutpa:T277:7: O bliss rising in the grace-flourishing Chidambaram, my love, O Siva shining so that all the expanding clusters of universes glow, O Lord ruling over the space beyond the towering silent space, O fruit of supreme bliss ripened to sweeten my fragrant heart.
arutpa:T372:21: The four-faced ones are very great, greater than them are the Narayanas, greater still if you search are the Rudras of the sky-like forms, greater than them are the Maheshvaras and Sadasivas, greater than them is the Nada in the fish-faced expanse, even greater is the Para within it, and greater still within that is the supreme Paraparam dancing with red feet—my friend, only those who know can understand.
arutpa:T158:222: The beauty of the red-flowered hand that sounds so that all self-rising worlds resonate, and flesh-thriving—
arutpa:T158:16: Becoming the universe, becoming the atom within the universe, becoming the undivided expanse of grace, becoming the form of bliss—
arutpa:T372:35: Within these five great elements, each grows denser than the other, holding what it grasps; the vast host of high shaktis, acting without losing their nature, stand and shine distinctly here and there, and when these accumulated awarenesses dissolve, performing many actions, shining as light, as the expanse of grace, who is able to analyze and tell the greatness of the sacred foot shining so fittingly in the open light, tell me, my friend.
arutpa:T158:61: Who is the siddha that makes all worlds unite without fading in the play of the unperishing little girl, without wearying—
arutpa:T347:53: Even if one declares many sectarian gods to be mere straw, it is enough to ponder the greatness of the wise one's grace; even if one says that the many regions of the universe are one in countless grains of atom dust, they are not enough for your golden feet, both for me and for you.
arutpa:T377:54: You ask me why I sit here wondering, not knowing the end. When you leave me, I remain like a lamp where no wind blows; how can I describe the state I saw then? In the great blazing light mountain of the outer and inner cosmos, within the Supreme Nada, there appeared one entity—is it unaltering golden light, or the light of the dancing Vallal's grace? This is a wondrous thing.
arutpa:T161:51: O Supreme Expanse, my Siva, O wish-fulfilling tree rich in sacred grace, your habit is to give to those who reach you; it is not small, but knowing by the words of great supreme sages that it is uncontained by many universes, I have sought you.
arutpa:T292:25: O jewel-lamp of light that burns un-fanned, shining so that all within the outer and inner cosmos and all categories of the microcosm glow, neither shaking nor extinguishing even when struck by a fierce, unspoken gale; O shining moon that never hides, wanes, is tainted, confuses, or grows cold; O King of the dancing light shining as Lord within, without, and in all lives, adorn me with your song and grant your grace.
arutpa:T292:34: O blissful light shining sweetly so that the established first four of the five established omkars pervade and fill four-by-four alternate places, making the hidden true wealth and its meanings clear; O great blazing radiance spreading rays so that the omkar world and omkar universe glow as homes; O supreme King of dance who dances in the hall as all devotees praise with song, adorn my song too and grant your grace.
arutpa:T257:18: The greatness of the beginning and end of a Brahma's universes cannot be calculated; a thousand crore of Vishnu universes, crore upon crore of Aran universes, countless crores of Iesan universes, Sadasiva universes, and the bright, innumerable shaktis and sathers' glorious universes—how can I speak of them? As all these universes stir like tiny atoms in the space of grace, standing in the midst of that space and dancing, O King of supreme compassion, embrace me, make me your son, O true father who gave the boon of immortality, O single God standing in the midst of the jeweled hall, O all-powerful Lord Nataraja.
arutpa:T377:45: Why are you startled, my friend? Who is it scolding you, saying, 'You have garlanded the husband who dances in the assembly'? Whatever the sathers, sathis, and others throughout the outer and inner cosmos speak of is nothing other than the greatness of Vallal's dance of grace; does not Vedas and agamas declare the nature of this sweeping, blazing light's sacred dance?
arutpa:T158:607: You who existed here as an atom, stretched out like the eight directions—this is not a proper way; you do not want—
arutpa:T316:113: The Grace-Vast-Light that shines, filling countless, incalculable universes—
arutpa:T257:22: Though giving to all lives in the outer and inner cosmos across aeon upon aeon, alas, becoming a fullness that never wanes even a little, O treasure joyfully found by this humble self! O Vallal who spoke aloud, 'May you live long aeons,' and granted the boon of immortality! O full moon of my intellect, shining moon-amrit, joy born of moon-amrit, O Guru who raised me to the supreme state free of night and day where all those in the seven and seven worlds marvel, saying 'What is this?,' making me rejoice! O King who told me to protect and nurture all lives with the ocean and ornaments, O fearless Lord Nataraja shining as the full syllable 'A' and beyond!
arutpa:T292:20: O form-expanse, O form dwelling within the form-expanse, O single one where the middle of the form and the middle of the expanse became one! O great expanse, O supreme light essence within the great expanse, O unique entity shining in the midst of the supreme light essence! O jewel of light shining within the unwithering flower, O mantra, O tantra, O priceless medicine! O King of dance in the unwaning, towering jeweled hall, do not scorn my small words, but accept them and grant your joy.
arutpa:T372:23: One of the two kinds of earth and other five elements stands as a natural minute atomic shakti, with sights beyond the reach of eye-consciousness; approaching from within, outside, below, above, and the middle, becoming nine as three, five, four, three, eight, giving a supporting shakti to all the shaktis uttered at the root, who knows the greatness of the dancing feet? Those who know, know, my friend.
arutpa:T159:13: Is the great form a pillar of light? Is the glorious form of cinmaya a divine form? When all the macrocosm and microcosm joined in exact form stand and dissolve at the tips of your toes.
arutpa:T44:8: O pure wonder who once took the form of Mount Meru so that Mal, Ayan, Rudra, the heavenly ones, humans, beasts, birds, crawling things, mountains, oceans, and all else, along with hundreds of crores of dancing, moving universal expanses, became your own form! O adept who sports in bodily form with bow and peacock! O essence of the Vedas! O true essence of the stainless one with the moon in his matted locks! O mountain of good qualities praised by ascetics! O supreme one! O ruby of Shaivism seated at the holy place of Thanikai! O Shanmuga!
arutpa:T273:7: Yielding the five acts instead of just one, and causing all this swelling macrocosm and microcosm to go and shine according to your will; the light of grace that said 'Do not despair' entered deep within me and filled me with all strength—he is my master.
arutpa:T237:2: Behold the single God in Chidambaram, where all the shining expanses—beginning with the colorful elemental space and material space, becoming the radiant space, the thought-filled great silent space, the supreme space spoken of above it, the dual space, the overarching supreme space of chit, the space of the absolute, and the settling great expanse—turn into the true space of grace and bliss.
arutpa:T248:86: O good father of justice, who art all the supreme principles, the radiant light shining in the void, the space where all light glows, the great expanse where all space shines, and in the blessed wisdom-hall beyond that, performing grace: henceforth I will not be born, I will not die, I will not part from you; is it right for your child to wither in grief?
arutpa:T160:63: We know the intermediate sky here, and we know that the cosmos is arranged in layers within it; we know the state of the many bodies arising there, and the state attained by the soul, yet alas, alas, we have not known even by a sesame seed's measure the grace-play of our father who establishes all this—O primordial Lord, whom countless ancient Vedas praise, O god who fulfills the devotees' lack!
arutpa:T316:646: O supreme gem that showed the cosmos, the cosmos above it, and the contents within them!
arutpa:T292:9: Whatever the measure of the cosmos, so is the measure of mobile and immobile beings set within them; O unique king who, being manifest as what is seen, dances in the hall, having planted a flag of supreme compassion in the midst of the glorious, marvelous grace-light-vastness shining distinctly within, without, in the inner-without, and in the outer-without, and running a single straight scepter of grace—please wear my garland of verse upon your feet.
arutpa:T257:20: O deity who dances the dance of bliss in the divine grace-vastness, which is declared to be the radiant body of primordial Bindu and primordial Nada, extending as the supreme purity up to the primordial Nada, along with elemental things, senses, inner instruments, cosmic nature, and instruments starting from time; O mother who raises me by giving an imperishable town and more; O high father; O true companion within my heart; O my relation; O my love; O my joy; O my life; O king who placed me in the high state unknown to anyone; O light of grace; O supreme Lord of the dance of ambrosia, who art the entirety of the 'A' state and art also full beyond it.
arutpa:T316:618: O my unique consciousness that flawlessly illuminates all the cosmic worlds and others!
arutpa:T225:89: The space of elements, the space of inner instruments, the space of cosmic nature, the space of maya's enjoyment, the space of great maya's yoga, the space of spoken Vedas, the space of lower bindu, the space of lower nada, the single space, the supreme space, the space of wisdom, the space of great nada, the pure empty space, the open vast space—while your feet grow weary dancing in all these spaces, for the sake of me, a helpless one, you came and reached me and gave me something in my hand; whose compassion equals yours?
arutpa:T261:9: Grant the fearless life of the true wisdom hall, praised by the pure Sanmarga association, which is the ancient, natural state giving a lofty, imperishable condition, where a radiant, unique, great compassionate light abides within the hearts of those who possess the wisdom untouched by even a flaw of harm.
arutpa:T316:281: O grace-vast-light that fashioned the pure, good vastness into the flawles supreme vastness!
arutpa:T347:23: Your command prevails both inside and outside the cosmos; the Vedas declare that you are the almighty one. O great light that fills both inside and outside the physical body, what justice is this that you shine within a wretch like me, between you and me?
arutpa:T257:9: O light that benefits the great, well-formed sages by being in the wind that is spoken of, in the wind's core, in the beginning, middle, and end of the wind, forming the shapes of many billions of powers, abiding in that dance's fullness, in the zeal, and in the many natures of the wind, where they rise and bear them; O cool moon that joys in every living thing, becoming full of ambrosia as a thousand billion rays stream forth while the waning moon stands abashed; O embodiment seen by the pure wisdom of patience and firmness; O turiya state; O treasure of pure Siva Sanmarga; O supreme Lord of the dance of ambrosia, O great light of grace.
arutpa:T305:5: Come, O rare, great master of consciousness who packs all the cosmos into an atom! Come, O wondrous one, here. Come, come.
arutpa:T257:13: O light filled and mixed so that the inner states and reckoned outer states of various colors—beginning with the foot and ending with it in those endless billions of primal parts, starting from the single cosmic part, the second part, the egoistic part above it, and many primal parts—and the assemblies increasing more and more, shine clearly; O form of many shapes; O quality; O mark bearing qualities; O un-markable supreme turiya; O pure Siva turiya; O unique wisdom-vastness containing all; O sweet yoga-experience felt and enjoyed within the hearts of devotees; O treasure of pure Siva Sanmarga; O supreme Lord of the dance of ambrosia, O great light of grace.
arutpa:T305:94: Come, O exalted Lord of the dance who supports the great vastness that bears the towering micro-macrocosms! Come here to set things right. Come, come.
arutpa:T362:8: O leader of the wisdom-hall who shines as all things, becoming light, inner light, light within inner light, light of light's light, a light even within that light, space, space of space, space upon space, great space above space, space for the great space, becoming love, becoming that, and becoming other than that, being beyond the beyond and also the beyond's other, and being the fullness—how is one to declare your nature?
arutpa:T292:68: O supreme Siva-vastness, standing boundlessly high as the vastness encompassing within itself those soaring vastnesses which the spread-out great Vedas, though they went separately and measured them, grew weary and faint over without finding the truth of their measure, taking the supreme vastness, middle vastness, peaceful vastness, and desolate vastness as the first among seven vastnesses beyond; O sweet king of the dance, please wear my thought also.
arutpa:T146:8: Though the Lord who desires and dances in the hall of Puliyur sits unmoving while all the cosmos moves, the people of Otrriyur have not yet come near. If I say with music, 'Come here and embrace me,' and even then they are not willing, what shall I do? Will not foolish women mock me?
arutpa:T372:24: O friend, who can speak of the power of the holy feet that dance the elemental dance in the midst of the space that is an atom within the subtle atom starting from the earth element, being the inner light of that which is deemed so, the light within that light, the space shining within that light of the eight elements, and the space existing as a space within that proper space? The Lord of Nataraja graciously places His lotus feet upon my head with affection.
arutpa:T257:1: O blazing flame shining clearly to make us understand the experience of true wisdom that exists without beginning or end, becoming the form of fullness above the outer-outer, inner-outer, outer-inner, and inner-outer, while countless billions of macrocosms, microcosms, and all mobile and immobile beings along with the countless principles and powers starting from creation shine gloriously and grandly right in the middle of the Siva-bliss-exceeding vastness called the wisdom-hall where the state of grace shines; O sweet companion to Ananda Valli, the queen with coiled dark tresses, and to Siva Sundara; O treasure of pure Siva Sanmarga; O supreme Lord of the dance of ambrosia, O great light of grace.
arutpa:T75:6: Even if the eight directions change, the seven oceans overflow onto the earth, the lofty shining lights fall away, there is no rain, food alters in the world, the seven worlds are overwhelmed, and all the cosmos falls and changes—I will never forget the holy, gracious name of Namasivaya, our lord, the naked one whom the Vedas do not know.
arutpa:T292:38: O pure, unique flame spreading light so that all the worlds of supreme sound fill and shine; O great light that bursts forth, explaining its own nature of having become everything and being the supreme beginning among the five supreme sounds, pervading and fulfilling the primordial states within them, in the examined supreme Siva-vastness where space takes form; O king who dances in the hall adorned with gems, please wear my arranged garland of words so that it shines.
arutpa:T292:36: O unique flame soaring by spreading light so that the entire world-cosmos shines with the light of the supreme power dwelling in the heart; O great light that pervades everywhere, filling the spotless supreme vastness without showing its beginning, middle, or end, while all the expanded states among the supreme ones of the shining supreme powers provide light; O king who performs the great dance in the wealth-blessed holy hall, please wear my garland of words with joy.
arutpa:T278:1: They say that at the time of dancing in the shining golden hall, the state of the heavenly sacred feet existed as if a part in a billion of an inseparable atom, closely crowded among all those immense gatherings whose numbers are hard to see, belonging to the boundless cosmos containing many tens of millions of worlds.
arutpa:T127:50: How is it that you, who gave birth to all the speaking, diverse cosmos and all the dense mobile and immobile beings within that cosmic expanse, and surround them, are still called an undiminishing young maiden? O form of abiding bliss-life, O ruby of a form!
arutpa:T283:6: The one who is the grace-great-light surpassing all causes, being the cause enclosed by all lights, a brilliant light showing neither down, up, nor middle as all the supreme light that performs the five cosmic acts from creation onwards is found within an atom—that unique one entered and sat within the heart of tiny me, who reached the end; who can stop God?
arutpa:T292:11: O King of the dance of justice, who sits in the grand state of the pure true-gnostic auspicious Siva-sanmarga, while countless crores of various powers and sage-worlds—from the primal Pure-Para-Sakti world to the final Jnaana-Sakti world—shine under your shade, and your golden crown gleams, and you wield the solitary scepter of extended supreme grace: graciously wear and accept my long word.
arutpa:T377:47: O naive woman with a thin waist, you spoke of my husband as a dancer performing in the open hall. Know by hearing that all the manifestations of stations on earth, in the sky, in the netherworld, and in crores of macrocosms and outer worlds are indeed the display of the sacred dance performed by the Lord with foot-blossoms, proclaiming this with drums so that ancient vedas and agamas fade away, thereby removing all your distress.
arutpa:T158:73: Who is the adept who causes action and joins it—in the sweat born of the body, in the fallen earth, and in the cosmos—and grants salvation?
arutpa:T330:5: I came to know that the song sung by all ancient, praised Vedas is your very song, O Supreme Being! Even if those with tongues of thousands upon thousands of crores say it, if describing even an atom's fraction is difficult, alas, I—this small one—have dared to speak so that my mouth does not grieve. The desire of my mind is an ocean, greater than seven oceans. You are like a mother who embraces [her child] right before it cries out, O Guru of Shiva-gnana shining in the holy Chidambaram.
arutpa:T237:7: Behold, there is indeed one single Supreme God who stands towering as all-powerful in the shining, auspicious Chitrambalam: filling all cosmos, all bodies, all lives, all objects, and all places without any gap, taking whatever was taken, giving space to take and take yet more without weariness, standing far beyond all regions as the expanse, and even beyond that as the outer space, and even beyond that as the solitary open space.
arutpa:T158:683: Seeing grace beyond, seeing oneself by grace, seeing the supreme open space beyond, and even beyond that beyond—
arutpa:T237:5: Behold, in the holy Chitrambalam shines the one God, possessing everything, capable of everything, having become everything, yet being none of those things, impossible to be measured and concluded by words, meanings, or arising intellect, becoming that very thing in the experience of the mighty ones who have transcended the turiya space, and when they ponder it, being hard to attain yet vast, penetrating even into states where not an atom can go.
arutpa:T292:80: O King of the dance who sports in the pure Siva-essence shining as one that is fully filled, to whatever extent the universe-types are, to that same extent the lives settled in them, to that extent the perceived objects, to that extent the measure of their mingled integration, completely filling all spaces such as the sky-worthy sound-space, pure space, silent space, and knowledge-space: take my faults also and be gracious.
arutpa:T257:5: O Supreme Lord of the dance of the ocean of grace, O treasure of pure Siva-sanmarga, O light shining with independence in the hearts of stainless, tranquil Siva-sages, O lamp in the great mansion of my mind, O deity able to make all siddhis act, O bliss experienced near the summer-mouth of the moonlit gem-terrace, O substance blending and rising as sakti and sat, in the state devoid of arts, in the nature, in the seed, in the guru, in the formless perceived by no eye, in the form, in the density of forms, in their rise, in their ascent at the middle, and at the beginning of countless macrocosms and outer worlds!
arutpa:T257:15: O substance shining as the Siva who dances in the middle of that very hall, which is the well-joined golden hall of Chitrambalam, and the auspicious Chitrambalam, and the expanse, and light of light, and light clinging within, and feeling within feeling, and feeling, and life entering within life, and primeval seed, and bodily stature up to the mountain, and atomic beginnings: O Guru who granted divine speech commanding all siddhis to be done and comforted me and showed grace, O true-gnostic life that sustained me as other things combined, O boon of my life, O single God standing in the middle of the gem-hall, O all-powerful Nataraja!
arutpa:T377:26: O naive girl, you ask, "Did you call him father? Son? Bridegroom? Is this proper here?" Think and see for yourself: the fortunate husband who united with me, dancing in the Chitrambalam, is that rare, supreme light with neither beginning, middle, nor end. He is the one who witnessed all macrocosms and micro-worlds, and there is nothing else. Why would I speak any falsehood like other people? Ah, mother, I know not that his majestic divine form is myself.
arutpa:T377:27: The sole leader capable of doing everything, the rare supreme light dancing in the open hall, approached and married me, O good woman, so that all the people of the land would know. Because he is the virtuous one, I have no poverty; what shall I speak of as my great wealth, which I give to everyone, mother? I know not of the Siva-gnana supreme wealth excelling even beyond unreachable worlds!
arutpa:T209:22: O white moon, what is this saying that all macrocosms and outer worlds are the dance of the Lord, O white moon?
arutpa:T159:79: Where is Vishnu's place? Where is the high life of Brahma? Where is Indra's red scepter? Where is the dwelling of the celestials? Where is the beauty-laden cosmos? Where are those respective rare entities? Your neck is there, O unblinking cool-rayed one.
arutpa:T7:23: Bound and suffering by the deceptive rope of worldly origins and others, I cry and my mind melts as I wander here. O you who see all macrocosms starting from the earth in a single second, did you not see the drooping face of this sinner? O wealth of grace of the primeval lord, O honey welling up so that the flower of my mind blossoms, O gem of Thanigai the ancient mountain of bliss, O natural life that fills and shines as the witness of all lives!
arutpa:T159:11: Is it in the cosmos, or beyond them, or this side of them? Is it in ancient things, or in the chit-prakasa open space? O my fierce Lord, where your eyes rest, is it in the true hearts of those who have renounced—where you live together with the lady, O my Lord?
arutpa:T292:31: O light shining as knowledge alone as its form, filling even beyond the great maya along with the four—great maya, supreme, and the rest—and illuminating those four four through its own nature! O solitary, great, radiant sun making the worlds of great maya and the great-maya cosmos thrive and shine! O divine King of the dance who dances in the hall while Vishnu and Brahma stand and praise, graciously accept my little word.
arutpa:T316:393: O Supreme Grace-Light that cures the impurities of the micro-body and the great soul!
arutpa:T159:12: Where are the elements? Where are the other senses? Where are the differences of many lives? Where is the great name called cosmos? Where is the sound? Where is the primal form? Where is the Veda—when the supreme heavenly entity does not assume a golden form?
arutpa:T236:4: O mountain caught in the grip of love! O king who enters the hut of love! O supreme being caught in the net of love! O nectar seated in the hands of love! O ocean contained within the pot of love! O knowledge glowing as the life of love! O great light residing within the atom of love! O supreme Siva who is the very form of love!
arutpa:T160:44: O God of immense compassion who, though all cosmos be taken as eyes, stands blended everywhere as the expanse within the expanse of silence, while endless Vedas scream, cry out, and lament that even an atom's fraction cannot be seen! O true Guru, Siva Guru, god of peace, who shows the chit-maya so that the beginning of fierce karma is cut off, you who are seen as the form and are the all-pervading expanse-essence!
arutpa:T314:16: The light within the supreme grace-light—the light where all macrocosms and micro-worlds shine; the light that has grown full with love; the great gem-light unattainable by mind and word. Siva Siva.
arutpa:T160:55: O God who becomes extremely distant as endless Vedas grow weary and declare that you cannot be measured by anyone, while one can measure all the named cosmoses, the very many types of micro-bodies, all the various things coming into the micro-cosmos, oceans, earth, mountains, oceans, sands, sky, unmoving stars in the sky, atoms, and other existing things!
arutpa:T377:7: They say that the smile shining dazzlingly on the face of him who performs the public dance is worth a crore of gold; is it only this much? Even if it is many crores, is that any measure? Whenever one thinks of the smile of that praised lord—whom the saktis and sathers individually direct in the countless crores of cosmos-types spoken of by the four true Vedas—does not the mind obtain the sweet nectar that wells up?
arutpa:T375:8: O female friend, you know and it is not unknown to you: the world knows that the nature shining by removing the entrenched darkness is that light alone is the macrocosms and outer worlds, shining and rising, filling the single macrocosms and outer worlds outside the expanse, inside and outside, and in the outer-inside and outer-outer. That agamas declare it is true—that there is no other substance besides the light-essence, and that all things are indeed He.
arutpa:T318:1: Eye found within the eye, looking outward with overflowing grace, thought's essence matured into a fruit of love, knowledge found within awareness as its very truth; Guru who seated light filling both inside and out, flame shining in the gem-hall that transcends the five elements; Lord who can do all, King dancing the transient dance within my heart, my mother, who gave me myself, sole supreme Lord, this is indeed the moment granted now.
arutpa:T292:35: Light that shines and settles as supreme reality among the ancient supreme powers, spreading rays so that manifold wonderful universes and worlds of supreme power may attain bliss; flame shining to make lovers' hearts rejoice, King of the cosmic dance in Chidambaram, adorn and grace my speech.
arutpa:T292:30: Light that spreads beyond the four primary domains and their four counterparts, ruling with a scepter of sole light so all becomes its own form; grace-flame spreading to illuminate worldly realms and cosmic spheres; King of the subtle dance who dances in the hall as worshipful gods praise, adorn and grace my word.
arutpa:T360:6: Father beyond the universes, father beyond the outer cosmos, father with the poison-adorned sapphire throat, father who has seen all, father who took the radiant ascetic maiden Sivakami, father with the crescent moon on his braided hair, father who uttered the Vedas, surround and grace me.
arutpa:T303:12: Feet that are the support for rare life, feet that sustain universes and worlds, feet that grant joy to approaching life, feet of the treasure of true wisdom and grace.
arutpa:T372:13: They say the space where the dance is performed is the pristine five-element space, instrumental space, shining space, turiya space, and bliss space; who indeed has the power to know and tell the true form of the lotus feet of our Lord, the skillful Nataraja, who dances as the embodiment of consciousness, full of bliss, perfect within those spaces? Tell me, my friend, is it in my power?
arutpa:T360:78: Great medicine placed at one side with the maiden, gem, what is within your divine mind I do not know, what shall I do for this? Alas, days pass, I do not know even an atom of the trick of reaching you, your pair of feet is my only refuge.
arutpa:T283:8: Lord of boundless gift who does not lessen even by an atom's share even if all the living souls in crores of universes are seized at once; forgiving all faults of my deceitful heart, sweetly granting all thoughts, he entered my inner self with irresistible power; who can stop the father?
arutpa:T316:752: Lamp shining in the middle of the formless space, with sun-light gleaming across all the dark void.
arutpa:T283:7: Great Lord who transcends all measure, the great one who stood so that when all layers of universes are divided into one-ten-millionth of an atom's split, he is proclaimed; casting away all deceit, filling all my thoughts, giving the sweet nectar of grace, he enters the wealth of the heart and grows; alas, who can stop the philanthropist?
arutpa:T306:8: Dance, you who have seen all universes! Dance, you who are the expanse of complete fullness! Dance, you who created all objects! Dance, you who are free from attachment and liberation! Dance, you who came and ruled me! Dance, you who are skilled in dancing! Dance, you who possess the worthy golden hall! Dance, you who are my lord!
arutpa:T292:95: Eye-filling flame spreading its rays in the middle of the great space that transcends calculation and convention; lamp of light shining sweetly right in the middle of the heart-space of harmonious lovers; fragrant scent, sole reality glowing in my heart, my life, my medicine, King dancing the great dance in the gem-hall surrounded by strife-free great sages, adorn and grace my stammering.
arutpa:T187:8: Lord who shares his body with the woman, embodiment of supreme grace, greatest of the great, divine master with an eye on his forehead, Krishna, three-eyed ruler, who granted the gift of our sweet songs, creator and sustainer of earth and universes, possessor of unmatched beauty, I will meet and embrace him tonight.
arutpa:T292:81: Clear nectar shining as form-of-light, bliss-form, true Siva-experience in the grace-space, which does not decrease even by an atom's measure though all souls in countless crores of universe-regions—praised this way and that by truthful Brahma, Ananta, Narayana, other leaders, and those belonging to their respective worlds—experience it; King of the swift dance, adorn and grace my word.
arutpa:T158:60: Who is the siddha who gracefully confined all universes within an atom and firmly sustains them?
arutpa:T316:285: Grace-vast-light that created the great space within the great bliss space with grace.
arutpa:T160:40: Unfaltering stream of grace, radiance of the unquenched jewel lamp, flame continuously spreading rays in the sky, sole giver of unceasing bliss to lovers, shining god dwelling within the pure silent space, hard to be seen by the eyes, words, mind, true austerities, or any path spoken of by the celestials.
arutpa:T314:15: Light filled in the six limits - light that is also beyond them, light of the mighty vast space, light shining further in the open sky. Siva Siva.
arutpa:T158:580: Whatever is called universe, movement in the universe, or ancient matter not of movement—all possessed multiple faces.
arutpa:T316:374: Grace-vast-light that pours out outer-outer nectar of the universe and protects living beings so they may draw near.
arutpa:T316:14: Grace-vast-light rooted in the grace-space called the stable sole-space and Siva-space.
arutpa:T292:28: Sole fire mixed beyond the five elemental realms, the first four, the subsequent four within them, inside and outside, up, down, across, all directions becoming its own form; flame shining by spreading good rays so that gross-element worlds and cosmic-element varieties flourish; King of the dance shining in the gem-hall praised by those who have escaped the scorching elemental bonds, adorn and grace my speech.
arutpa:T82:2: My mind, come, let us select and weave garlands using rare, fresh flowers to adorn the shoulders of the lord of celestials, who dwells in proper, renowned Ooragam, wearing golden anklets that stood to confuse dark Mal when he became a dark bull, creating all large universes, and not shedding the name of a madman.
arutpa:T316:282: Grace-vast-light that royally created the transcendent space within the supreme space.
arutpa:T276:9: The very god, the single god, the very good god, the great god joined by all wise men as being of correct nature, the god shining in the Chit Sabha, the god who is light growing within each thing, the god beyond the vast space, the god beyond that, the god beyond whatever kind of god, the god who took seat in my mind, easily obtained by me though hard to reach by performing any kind of austerity.
arutpa:T160:12: O God who shines as the divine tree of wisdom, becoming countless worlds, exceeding their measures, and remaining as the boundless supreme; becoming infinite types of bodies, being the substance from which bodies arise, becoming many distinct objects, being the lord who protects them, ripening with bliss, possessing peace, spreading shade everywhere, and flourishing.
arutpa:T297:9: That is the growing atom, the atom is that growing, that is the relation in which the atom grows; the light is the growing radiance, the radiance is the growing light, that is the action in which light grows; the sweetness is the growing nectar, the nectar is the growing sweetness, that is the nature in which nectar grows; the open space is the growing expanse, the expanse is the growing open space, that is the open space where the lord of Siva grows.
arutpa:T209:21: O white moon, you became the atom within the atom - O white moon, what is the manner in which you became everywhere?
arutpa:T279:5: Rejoicing, I have seen our lord who dances in the open space: who is within, who is outside, who became the atom, who is the atom within the atom, who is within that, who is vast, who is vaster than the vast, who is the greatest of the vast, who is the brilliant earth, who became all worlds, who is the mother of immense grace that is solitary mercy, who is in this world and the beyond.
arutpa:T308:3: Having seen with a rejoicing mind, having drunk the nectar of Siva's bliss, and having resolved to dance in this open space while all the enlightened ones serve as your servants - if they say there is an open space greater than this there, those who come here will...
arutpa:T316:392: O Grace-Vast Flame that cuts off the flaws of the worlds and the flaws of the universe without leaving a trace.
arutpa:T316:751: O lamp planted right in the middle of the middle space, so that all open spaces shine with natural light.
arutpa:T316:651: O gem filled with radiance, allowing all the crores of worlds to be seen and grasped in half a second.
arutpa:T251:3: O ocean of nectar filled with eyes, my eye, the pupil within my eye, the cool moon, the radiance that spread light and flourished, the solitary flame, O grace-light that fills all the great worlds hard to measure, O king lord, see that I cannot bear this even a little longer.
arutpa:T377:28: The Brahmas and Narayanas and others seen in the sky suffer, performing great austerities for many days; alas, the vision I saw, they did not see. I know not what penance I, a woman in the world, performed. If there is no lack for the family seen by the king, I have become a family seen by the lord who wields a unique, great, righteous red scepter over all crores of worlds; all my flaws have ceased, and now I dwell upon the solitary, tall mansion.
arutpa:T110:9: O virtuous one, firm one who grants the substance of bliss even to those like us, one close to the grace clarified in the heart of true Siva-wisdom, one wearing the cool moon on your matted locks where the river Ganga abides, one who beheld the manifold worlds.
arutpa:T347:32: Knowing that I desired to know all the aspects of the expanse of worlds, you made it known, by stirring my intellect; afterwards you made known the ways embodied souls unite with bodies, the way the body separates from itself, and the way it does not separate. Between you and me.
arutpa:T237:1: Behold, there is only one god in the sacred Chidambaram who provides light to the letter 'A' state illuminating all Saktas, to all the Saktis seated with them, to all the classes of worlds arising through them, to all the bodily parts, to all the stations, to all souls reaching the 'I' sound, to all the instruments there, to all objects, to all experiences, to all liberation, and to all types of attainments beginning with the crown.
arutpa:T156:3: The diffused sky, the great flame-form, the vast, the ancestral, the infinite, the unblemished, the supreme world and beyond, eternal sovereignty, the supreme state, the supreme subtle, the supreme beyond, the disease-free, the unsupported, the beyond-senses, the supreme mysterious, the wondrous, the supreme bliss, the formless, the blooming, the destroyer of foes, the rise of supreme joy, the imperishable.
arutpa:T156:15: The unceasing twelfth-end state, the paired flower-like feet that grant the twelfth-end state, the flower-like feet that are witness to the hearts of Sakalas, Vijnanakalas, and Pralayakalas, the flower-like feet that achieve equanimity in the unceasing Anu-paksha and Sambu-paksha, the flower-like feet that are the inner life of the transcendent subtle and gross states abiding within themselves.
arutpa:T156:16: The sacred flower-like feet that bear the vast, boundless, diverse soul-domain of moving and unmoving; the flower-like feet that grant grace so that columns, bodies, worlds, universes, and Brahmas are struck down; the flower-like feet that are the universal creator of truth, tattvas, sakala, creation, preservation, and destruction; the noble flower-like feet where the stainless, self-luminous light shines so that the darkness of innate defilement is dispelled.
arutpa:T158:32: Who is the natural flame, transcending all flames as their prior light and posterior light, becoming the three lights - within the mold
arutpa:T158:63: Who is the adept who shines inside the supreme atom, taking a form and yet unattached, a tiny form hiding an inner light - beyond other forms
arutpa:T158:71: Who is the adept who gathers all the universe into the fingers of his foot during both night and day - in manifold ways
arutpa:T158:85: Who is the adept who makes all crores and crores of dense worlds enter a single red hair's root - without righteousness
arutpa:T158:88: Who is the adept who with valor is able to make a single atom a great mountain, and that great mountain a fine atom -
arutpa:T158:546: Alas, you have crowded into the dream called your world, enjoyment, body, and instruments - day after day
arutpa:T159:8: If the great ones do not know you even after seeing you with supreme knowledge, who can know? Shall I know you, O you who stand as the glorious open space, as the space within space, as the light within light?
arutpa:T159:98: Behold, it came to be known that your mind did not melt even a little to truly grant me your grace, considering that if all these karmas of mine were removed, the worlds would not be enough to hold me.
arutpa:T160:5: O God who shines in the silent expanse, becoming the state of Vedanta, the truth of Siddhanta, the wisdom of equality, the space of Nadanta, the middle of Mutranta, untouched by the nine states, the source that bore all ancient worlds, the liberation beyond the mind, ever unsuited to debating religious paths.
arutpa:T160:8: O God who is seated as all the instruments and bodies, the natural spirit, the time and supreme, the bondless space, the supreme, beyond that the absolute, becoming the nature that consumed the universe, becoming the peace that arose, silence, the state of great silence, the endless 'tom' word, the true state, the unified 'asi' word, and the transcendent.
arutpa:T160:10: O great God of immense compassion who shines as the oozing nectar welling up within the hearts of those like us whose thoughts have melted, being hard to see even in severe austerities practiced by immeasurable ancient times, sages, yogis, scholars, flowers, Brahma and others, endless Vedas, transcending secrecy and transcending the instruments.
arutpa:T160:13: O God shining as a rain-cloud pouring supreme compassion to fill a flood of bliss, becoming gold, gem, enjoyment, outer, inner, pure, earth, mountain, sea, moon, sun, and everything else, being before, after, middle, whole, roaring with sound, and spreading everywhere as lightning.
arutpa:T160:37: O God residing as the very life of my soul, who is the ocean of heavenly joy filling and transcending all measures, mind, other knowledge, transcending the thoughts of pure yogis, transcending stations, transcending one and two, transcending all surrounding deceptions, transcending all worlds and bodies, the light that dispels the darkness of all devotees' growth, the life of silence.
arutpa:T160:42: O King who sits unfailingly in the realm of grace, ruling the unique command called fierce resistance so that living beings survive, arranging row by row through the grace-space so that the tossing ocean, earth bounds, fire, wind, water, sky, and all other macrocosms do not lose their stability, O companion on the path of liberation, O God who is the gem within the eye of my companion.
arutpa:T160:43: O divine wealth of grace, ripened daily within the yoga of yogis whose supreme knowledge has ripened, O king of dance in the sky of consciousness, who is the lived experience where Shiva ripened as knowledge and bliss, O substance of the feet where the heads of celestials ripen, O great life where joy ripened in the true path, O ancient heavenly wish-granting tree called compassion.
arutpa:T160:46: O radiant God shining by spreading light throughout the space hard for the Vedas to touch, O feast that gives the medicine of Vedanta to every heart of those like us who cannot let go, O Kaveri of God who pours the honey of grace-flowers daily as ocean-like supreme bliss wells up deep within the hearts of true lovers so that bodies grow cool, souls flourish, feelings soar, and hearts melt.
arutpa:T160:65: O supreme reality standing alone, praised by all agamas as hard to endure, O God of peace, we completely followed the state of grasping, we saw all the states of supreme bindu, we slowly reached the state of natural supreme nada that burns bonds, we went even beyond that, we knew the three hard-to-know spaces, yet we know not even a little of your pure consciousness (chinmayam) anywhere as Shiva.
arutpa:T103:10: That the gem which shows arrogance knew that the sinful conduct I perform one day without restraint cannot be contained by the sky, cannot be contained by this earth, cannot be contained by the moon-world, and cannot be contained anywhere—for it to rule me is a great wonder.
arutpa:T89:7: Will you stand, O poor heart, thinking 'Who is a good support for us?' when Vishnu will sleep, the lotus-born will die, and all other celestials will utterly perish? Behold, the name of the supreme reality of the four great Vedas, which destroys and creates and protects even as thousands of billions of worlds shatter, is Namasivaya, the support we receive.
arutpa:T76:8: Our God is the one who, when thousands of millions of worlds trembled in fear before the king who knew not that he was more skilled than the skilled ones of beautiful Madurai, possessing the siddhi able to do all, gave sugar-cane to be eaten by a stone elephant.
arutpa:T76:10: Our God is the one who stands having made all the many thousands of millions of worlds—which bear loud sound, where went Indra, the four-faced one, Vamana, Rudra who took the deer, celestials, and all others above—shrink into a single quarter-foot.
arutpa:T113:8: O Lord of Thyagaraja residing in shining Ottiyur, O nectar in the hall shining in Tillai, O unique one who grants grace to billions of worlds, O pillar of bright light surging with night, will you grant me grace, thinking to cross the ocean of suffering driven by desire with my yearning heart, like those who cross heavenly rivers by lifting stones?
arutpa:T59:5: O rare gem shining in the eye, O vision, O dark sugar-cane of Ottiyur, O feast for the eyes coming as a bull, O light within the light shining in the sky, what do you know if you do what to me? I am a cruel, wretched one who does not think even a little to recall my mind that strays on earth and praise your flower-feet.
arutpa:T162:11: O Vaithiyanatha, crest-jewel of immortals, O mother who took the mother of virtue on one side, O dancer who, holding on the other side the cloud-colored one who measured the earth, makes all worlds dance, O outsider to the macrocosm of the dance, you wiped away my suffering, ruled me, and gave me the manner of true grace-knowledge.
arutpa:T97:1: O supreme lord residing in Ottiyur possessed of virtue, lamp of light shining in the hall of Tillai, my heart knows that I am a wretch who speaks nothing but wicked lies, being blue; even so, if I take refuge at your dancing feet, is it proper to reject me? If your nature of having consumed poison were to change, even billions of worlds would perish in that very moment.
arutpa:T183:2: O great God with an eye on the forehead, dancing with compassion in the hall, lord of the golden hall with lotus-like feet of knowledge, lord of the spiritual eye, treasure of compassion holding a conch, eight-shouldered god with a gem-set neck, rain-cloud making scientific rain that yields all harvest without a single seed, flame growing within a great expanse, you who gave light to all lights in the sky—grant grace to this dog, saying 'That day is this day,' on the day of crossing the forest of mind and Maya where living beings wander deluded and confused as the darkness of ignorance covers them without leaving even the space of a sesame seed, so that all fierce wild animals of countless desires roam incessantly.
arutpa:T183:3: O great God with an eye on the forehead, dancing with compassion in the hall, lord of the golden hall with lotus-like feet of knowledge, lord of the spiritual eye, treasure of compassion holding a conch, king with a gem-set neck, O moon roaming in the path of the full moon possessed by those of wisdom where the path of debate does not tread, O prime life of our life, rare medicine, supreme deity, when will you grant the day that I vanish, without output and without me, having found the supreme open space free from all sakala and kevala states spoken of by the Vedic path, having gone above after the dark ground called flawed delusion vanishes, leaving behind all paths from the nature of elements up to the path of nada in the three worlds?
arutpa:T183:8: O great God with an eye on the forehead, dancing with compassion in the hall, lord of the golden hall with lotus-like feet of knowledge, lord of the spiritual eye, treasure of compassion holding a conch, king with a gem-set neck, eight-shouldered god, fullness of joy, treasure of grace, my lord, relation of relation of feeling, feeling of feeling, life of life taking pride, form of the form of object-nature, beyond the space of nada, light of light—when I, a simple and small one, wander confused with a heart like cotton swirling in the wind of heaven, saying 'Are the faults I commit small? They are larger than the seven seas. What shall I do, what shall I do? Even from now on, not doing them, to praise you, Father'—grant knowledge so that my mind is in my control and I am in your control.
arutpa:T197:10: O great life and lord residing as light in every one of the countless lives, I desired not your great state transcending the sky, desired not purity, craved not your grace, was seized by a rough demon called the infatuation of overcoming women, and became like a tender fruit bitten by a dog. Like the tale of blind and mute ones beyond the eye, I will see and speak your glories—what shall I say, being the lowest of the low?
arutpa:T204:1: Sivachidambaram, Sivachidambaram, Sivachidambaram—the forehead-mark called our guru, the heart which is an incomparable joy free from the thought that the world and movable and immovable things are a great world moving again and again, and free from divisions of one or two, being the conscious space where conscious mass shines filled in every atom without conflict.
arutpa:T204:4: Sivachidambaram, Sivachidambaram, Sivachidambaram—that which grants clarity, destroys darkness, grants grace, and stands blending as light within the stainless, wise, heavenly space that grants no confusion, grants fame telling the end of the four Vedas granting wealth, and makes true lovers like the gooseberry on the palm of the hand.
arutpa:T229:1: Whenever I take into my heart your holy form shining in the high space transcending above, below, and middle, together with Sivakamavalli, the great queen and mistress with eyes joined with fish, possessing the form of Siva's joy—to say that it was like eating milk, crushed fruit, honey blended with syrup, and cow's ghee mixed together—even for eyes that see with delusion, it is impossible to think how it was right there.
arutpa:T235:4: O king whom every great sage calls the guru, who spoke the sacred agaval called the sacred cosmic section praised by the whole world as the great formless cosmos, tell me your thought as the solitary agaval that says 'be'.
arutpa:T8:9: Since holy texts declare that entering the minds of liars is not possible, O lord, craving your sacred grace, standing here afraid, I full of deceit, O radiance shining within the truthful, O bliss born of the seedless sky, O lord of shoulders embraced by both women, O lord of Tiruttani.
arutpa:T44:4: O primeval source of ancient things, O ancient Veda rising endlessly, O full pearl brought forth by the three-eyed sugarcane, O ripened three-fruits, O gold praised by him who bears the bull, O sacred perfection, O fresh flower fragrant with knowledge, O city entered by all poets, O lamp-light in the hearts of those who loathe worldly illusion resembling lightning, O true god shining and filling above, below, and middle, O fruit for those who possess the Shiva-yoga resembling themselves, O ruby of Saivism seated in the region of Tanikai, O Shanmukha.
arutpa:T173:17: O lord who says that there is nothing else in all the cosmos except shining full manifestation.
arutpa:T186:9: O heavenly tree growing on the earth which is the mind of loving ones following the true path wearing sacred ash and shining rudraksha beads, O steady fulfillment, O imperishable treasure adorned with glory, O unending sky, O vast pure open space, O shining supreme light, O unwritten Veda, O Veda's end, grant me grace to bathe in that sweet ocean of bliss where I, a sinner wandering in bushes, may become worthy of your sacred twin flower-feet, be freed from sorrow, and find rest, O lord with the river-adorned braided hair, O radiant Lord of Dance in the wondrous space-knowledge hall together with the goddess Sivakami.
arutpa:T206:2: Because he is beyond qualities having transcended defiling qualities, because he pervades and stands in all the prosperous worlds, because he is the shining universal pervader, ruling this universe and displaying unshakable goodness, he is the universal creator.
arutpa:T316:69: O vast grace-light that is everywhere, transcends all expanse, and is even beyond.
arutpa:T316:72: O vast grace-light that stands in the state of all supporting moving and unmoving things and shines accordingly.
arutpa:T316:86: O vast grace-light that is the outer-outer, inner-outer, and completely inner and outer.
arutpa:T316:168: O vast grace-light that dwells in my heart so all the worlds praise it, making endless light.
arutpa:T316:169: O vast grace-light that is sky within sky, sky beyond sky, closely filling.
arutpa:T316:170: O vast grace-light that is sky possessing sky, sky without sky, closely glowing.
arutpa:T316:179: O vast grace-light arranged closely to measure the broad state of sky-like Shiva.
arutpa:T316:247: O vast grace-light affectionately arranged with the expansive nature and connection in the open space.
arutpa:T316:250: O vast grace-light arranged with affection for the seed-state, expansive state, and subtle state in the open space.
arutpa:T316:251: O vast grace-light that illuminates with grace, having arranged the limit-state in the open space to shine.
arutpa:T316:253: O vast grace-light arranged with affection to expand the single open space into many within it.
arutpa:T316:254: O vast grace-light established to bestow grace by expanding many open spaces into many within them.
arutpa:T316:256: O vast grace-light arranged with affection to expand all things of the sky and others within it.
arutpa:T316:258: O vast grace-light arranged righteously by joining the outer front with the middle to form a single limit.
arutpa:T316:259: O vast grace-light arranged so that the outer encompasses the inner-outer through the connection of the inner-outer middle limit.
arutpa:T316:260: O vast grace-light established so that the outer limit encompasses the inner-outer through the connection of the inner-outer middle beginning.
arutpa:T316:262: O vast grace-light arranged gracefully so the inner limit joins the head with the cool inner middle.
arutpa:T316:264: O vast grace-light arranged in the expanse so the inner-outer limit joins the inner middle and outer head.
arutpa:T316:267: O vast grace-light arranged righteously by means of its outer middle to form the outer-outer middle.
arutpa:T316:274: Water amidst fire and earth amidst water, wonderfully crafted, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:276: Earth upon water and forms upon earth, crafted upon fire, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:278: The difficult-to-speak region amidst the life-space, the other-space crafted, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:279: That life-space and the knowing art-space, crafted without otherness, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:283: The supreme-pervading space within the transcendental space, crafted to dispel ruin, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:284: The transcendental space within the spoken vast space, crafted to banish distress, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:290: For all these spaces to shine, the worlds placed therein, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:291: For the towering worlds to gain light, the three lights crafted therein, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:296: The clarifying lords and the shining worlds, crafted to receive grace, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:297: The seed-like Shakti and the seed-worlds, powerfully crafted, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:298: The Omkara Shaktis and the worlds they possess, arranged right there, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:299: The lords of sound and the worlds spoken of, crafted in that manner, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:300: The sound-Brahman and the sound-worlds, affectionately crafted, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:301: The spoken Para-Shakti and the worlds residing therein, crafted without inner flaw, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:302: The Para-Siva abode and the Para-Siva worlds, arranged to reign, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:303: Countless Shaktis and numberless worlds, crafted to draw close, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:304: Limitless Shaktis and boundless worlds, crafted without measure, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:305: Life-class worlds, endless and innumerable, crafted without weariness, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:306: Flawless ocean types, endless, shoreless, limitless, crafted, O Vast Grace-Light!
arutpa:T316:489: Without grace not even an atom will stir, therefore praise grace's goodness, declared true Siva!
arutpa:T316:602: Though all these worlds are perceived here and there, none knows how many they are, O Unique Reality!
arutpa:T316:647: The body, the bodies contained within it, and the treasures within them, revealed by the Supreme Gem!
arutpa:T316:649: All heavenly states above and all foot-states below, guided to see, O Ether-Gem!
arutpa:T316:650: All earthly states and all word-feet entirely, guided to rely, O Arrow-Light Gem!
arutpa:T317:2: Innumerable endless crores of expanding cosmic spheres and all the embodied physical worlds that dwell within them, along with the gatherings of manifold things that occur everywhere, shining unceasingly both within and without, above and upon, so that true knowledge and bliss may glow—that which shines without lessening or ending within all this is the great soaring flame of grace, my king.
arutpa:T237:9: Behold, there is indeed one single Supreme God who rises in the Chitrambalam as the pure measure of strength—the Great Light that surpasses numbers, where the sun, moon, stars, and all the inner faculties alike become insignificant; the cosmic sphere and all other ensuing objects, starting from clusters of souls, blending seamlessly and shining without lack, both inside and outside, inner-outside and beyond, as the primeval glowing great light and the supreme light of that light.
arutpa:T242:19: O Lord, if you say that everything is yours and your actions alone, then are not my actions solely your actions? How is it that you are able to cast me aside? If you cast me out, is not the outside also your very nature? The righteous declare everywhere that all is filled with Siva, our Lord.
arutpa:T263:10: O crest-gem of Siddhas, my king of the sacred dance, in this fitting moment you must open the sacred door, show the great light of sacred grace, feed the sacred ambrosia, make my mind rejoice, blend into my body, melt into my heart, merge into my soul, unite with my consciousness, so that all worlds fold in obedience, becoming one and indivisible across the changing aeons, transcending all limits of time, and dancing your dance of grace in refined brilliance.
arutpa:T248:85: O rare great father in the open assembly who fills all the stated cosmic spheres individually, illuminates every rising physical world with light, and bathes and nourishes them in the river of bliss, I have longed for the gain of joy; I am a child to you, Lord—is it proper for you to be indifferent?
arutpa:T292:23: O pure dancing king of the unique assembly who lifted me above all distinctions of caste, lineage, and religion, and gave me the unique sacred ambrosia as the sole sovereign reality; O relationship that makes me attain the form of intuitive understanding without being taught, while you are the light filling the cosmos, the outer and inner realms, and all living souls, showing neither beginning, middle, nor end! Please wear and grace these words of mine.
arutpa:T292:29: O dancing king of the assembly who performs the dance while many worshippers stand and praise! O self-luminous flame that spreads its brilliance across all the inner instruments, worlds, and cosmic spheres, while the four outer and inner instruments and their four divisions blend so that all things declared become of your very nature, shining even beyond them, above, below, middle, and all around!
arutpa:T292:32: O dancing king of the assembly praised by truth-knowing, blissful Siddhas! O flame spreading its brilliance to illuminate all the pure, supreme worlds and eggs, dancing as a great light upon a lofty, enduring state where the four pure supremes and their four inner ones shine as a pure luminous form, forming the beginning, middle, and endless end of the eternal supreme expanse!
arutpa:T292:33: O dancing king of the assembly who dances to the delight of praising, true devotees! O light shining as the very nature of all things, filling the five stated arts, the four supreme beginnings, and the four nestled within them, permeating inner, outer, above, middle, and below, and spreading a glowing flame that encompasses all manifested arts, worlds, and cosmic realms!
arutpa:T292:37: O dancing king of the assembly whose grace is the fruit of disciplined penance! Do not scorn my low words; adorn yourself with them and rejoice. O great spreading light that has become the nature of supreme bliss, filling the compassionate, singular Siva-space without a gap, so that the known great pure beginnings and the excellent states within them shine clearly! O flame that illuminates the state of true knowledge and bliss across all expanded great pure cosmic worlds!
arutpa:T292:58: O dancing king of the assembly shining in the jewelled hall, praised by all the Vedas that measure out honey! You are the reality that shows itself as matching whatever I measure, yet instantly becomes without measure, appearing as the final limit within the very measure by which it is measured, while remaining far beyond your own measure. Can anyone measure the great sky, when you have placed endless crores of skies that the sky cannot measure?
arutpa:T292:67: O Siva who made me rule, crowning me with sovereignty and making me of blissful form so that wherever cosmic spheres and physical bodies exist, they proclaim 'It is my king!'; while all the principles that governed me individually came under my control and bowed in humble service, and past, present, and future kings praised me! O my king, my life, my two precious eye-jewels, please adorn yourself with these words of mine addressed to your golden flower-feet.
arutpa:T292:78: O dancing king who gave a luminous form to the great ascetics who renounced the flesh and displayed your dance! O great wealth placed in my heart by the sacred five letters that shine apart from worldly delusions during my playful childhood! O joy residing in my life! O sky that shines in pure radiance, free from fish! O vast expanse encompassing endless skies! Please wear and grace this speech of mine.
arutpa:T278:2: I have known and perceived upon the tip of the smallest nail of the left foot dancing in the uninterrupted Chitrambalam that the uninterrupted Brahma, Vishnu, Rudra, Mayeswaran, Sadasiva, Bindu, the uninterrupted Brahman, high Parasakti, and the proclaimed Para-Sivam are mere dust-specks.
arutpa:T278:3: I shall praise the state of the sacred feet, knowing them to be the dust gleaming to banish suffering outside the sandals of the twin feet that dance the sacred dance in the luminous gem assembly—those beings being Brahma, Vishnu, Aran, Mayeswaran, Sadasiva, the spreading Bindu, the Pranavap-Brahman, Parai, Param, and Paran, who are obstructed by the density of binding impurity.
arutpa:T278:4: I recognized them as tiny worms dwelling in binding impurity, unworthy to enter even the outer side of the sandals of the flower-feet in the assembly—those gods of the wandering realm such as Indra, Vishnu, Brahma, and Eesan, along with the religious gods moving in greatness. Beyond that, I perceived them in the light dwelling within the hearts of those who have transcended worldly attachments.
arutpa:T278:6: They stated in the assembly that the golden-hued elements beginning with earth, along with the sky within, outside, below, and above, and the known waking states and sides, are established as saktis, while on both sides regarding the corresponding saktas, both aspects appear so that the conceptual forms and the rest become clear.
arutpa:T278:7: They say in the assembly that the nature of the feet is that whenever the ancient limits of the realms whose numerical extent is hard to know, along with their expanding varieties, are established everywhere on both sides from the starting bow to the final end, each one acts as the peak of instruments in a dual manner.
arutpa:T278:8: They say in the assembly that when the varied types and counts of the great maya that rises in the assembly multiply into endless crores upon crores from one another, all of them dance as the saktas along with the saktis, presiding so that the form and taste of that established state shine brightly.
arutpa:T277:9: O our Lord of supreme compassion who rises in the sky-flourishing Chitrambalam! O great light filling all worlds as the life of living bodies! O central gem of the luminous expanse that shines far beyond the great earth and primeval deities! O ripened fruit of supreme bliss that has grown sweet within my heart!
arutpa:T319:6: O mother, my father, my lord, my king who expanded all piled-up cosmic spheres into mere atoms! O pure supreme flame that sprouted in my mind to banish all dense darkness of ignorance and grant liberation, removing all my trembling fear, granting the undying nectar of wisdom, and bestowing all-accomplishing siddhis upon this small one who clung to you like a child holding a finger!
arutpa:T323:2: How shall I speak of the merit I have performed? I attained true life by receiving into my hands the true reality made by the sky which approached the public assembly; the king caused me to make all the many crores of cosmic spheres and the physical world parts made within them.
arutpa:T256:7: Forgaving the hard sins committed by this devotee who transcended the mountains, you made me your own and ruled me. When the glory of your ocean of grace rises, transcending all directions of the cosmic and physical spheres across the waves and going beyond all shores, if it is said that my heart has gone beyond speech, what can I understand or what can I utter?
arutpa:T322:1: O Lord of the brilliant gem assembly! She said, 'He came and adorned me with a garland.' She said, 'He granted me a body that does not decay even if aeon upon aeon passes.' She said, 'He graced me to sustain all worlds surrounded by the ocean.' My gentle one declared, 'He placed me high upon the seven-storied mansion.'
arutpa:T372:9: Those who have crossed faults declare—and we hear it—that the feet which do not dance the ananda-atita sacred dance in the sacred space beyond the waves, but dance as the supreme of the supreme beyond Parai spreading across all the space where Parai resided, are the sacred feet of my unique lord, the holy Nataraja, who is rich in merit. Can I tell the truth of him, whose lofty shoulders bear sacred ash beyond all bounds? I cannot, O female friend, behold!
arutpa:T372:20: Creation is one in an atom, smaller than small; in that subtle seed a subtle karana-karu; smaller than that seed, in the fearful moon's halo, smaller than the moon, shining within a radiant great flame, in it the clarifying shakti is extremely small, and in a crore of ways it is a tiny part in Chitrambalam, where my Lord dances in grace—who can speak the greatness of His grace? You do not know, my friend.
arutpa:T372:22: The earth has an endless crore of measure, water in it shines a hundred and one crores, above that fire is counted in thousands, ayutams, crores, and over a hundred thousand, eighty-four, and more with wind and sky, reaching up to the vast ether, the source, souls, great maya, kudilai, vindu—words cannot end it. If all these kinds are within the tiny toe-nail of the Lord's foot, who can speak His greatness? You do not know, friend.
arutpa:T372:28: The nature of the seed of the five elements is manifold, the nature of the sprout is very varied, the natures flourishing at the base are manifold and very many, the natures resting in the middle are manifold and very many, and the manifold natures assumed at the end are countless and varied, becoming the conjunctions of each and yet dancing without being caught within those that seek Him—who is there to speak of the greatness of those beautiful, gracious feet, oh friend?
arutpa:T372:32: In the sky the prime three flowers expand, from one flower comes an endless host joined by the shakti; within that nature, an endless host is commanded by the union of thirty-six crores of empowered shaktis. These solids and all their modes stand separately and shine, remaining and mingling yet unmingling within them like the sky, playing—who is there to utter the greatness of those feet, oh friend?
arutpa:T372:33: In the sky the prime three flowers expand, as one flower expands, another flower expands, so these five flowers open in the eye, another flower blossoms in the eye, and letting go of another flower blossoming, the seven flowers become four in the female and three in the male, undivided yet divided, shining and arranging body and instruments, standing and shining in the midst—who is there to tell the greatness of those good sacred feet, oh friend?
arutpa:T372:34: In the fertile flower, many forms, many colors, many natures of light esteemed above, the truths of light, within the light many affection-born shaktis, among shaktis shining many nadas, amidst the nada in one ray fittingly many dances, many names, many places shown—becoming the lord of all these, mingling with them in the public hall yet unmingling, who can utter the grace of those seeing sacred feet, oh friend?
arutpa:T372:37: In the manifested five elements, an indescribable nature shines; in it many crores of clan-holding gurus flourish. Among them many crores of asalai are established, and among those an endless number of amalai. They fill and overflow, and hard to enumerate, shining splendors exist. In them is the rooted tara-shakti, and in its midst the abiding sacred feet—who is there to speak of their greatness, oh friend?
arutpa:T372:38: In the encompassing five elements, the forms of shakti are beyond speech and mind, limitless and undiminished. They stand and shine separately, and within them holding nine radiances, so that radiance may flourish, a shakti-state shines forth, and thinking upon that shakti, becoming abiding shaktas, shaking and standing and dancing the deep parampara—who is there to speak of the greatness of those feet, you do not know, my friend.
arutpa:T372:40: In the green-hued five elements, the spoken tastes are many crores; among those birth-shaktis, wealth-hued diverse nine shaktis shine by the crore. Among them the primal one shines; that primal one has ten hues, within it separately Onkari approaches, and within her the single Parai approaches. In the midst of the space-hued Parai, who is there to speak of the great form of the sacred feet performing the sacred dance, oh friend?
arutpa:T372:41: Within the blossoming flame-flower, surrounding outside, blossoming and bearing fruit abundantly as moon-nectar drips and ripens, how can one know even a little of the manner in which the great-natured great light shines in the jeweled hall? Vedas praise, ascending and descending—if those who know speak thus, for this small one to praise, seeing it and rejoicing, what can I say of the foot's greatness shining in that hall, oh friend?
arutpa:T372:42: Within the wealth-yielding atom, a moon, sun, and fire shine as stars; all these appear and settle as chit-sok, para-shakti-filled, becoming a separate shakti-form, all tattvas entering the heart—when Vedas wail asking what world can measure and know the grace-feet of the single Lord who dances the sacred dance in the jeweled hall, can this little handmaid speak it? You do not know, my friend.
arutpa:T372:43: In the pervaded five elements, under the gross shakti, Para presiding, in the delusion of nada and vindu, mingled tattva-atoms unite one with another and shine. At their base, middle, and peak, in a threefold way, urging life forward and making intelligence known, who on earth knows and speaks of this light-dance performed in the lofty sacred Ampalam? Is it for this small, lonely one to declare? Tell me, my friend.
arutpa:T372:44: On one peak of the flame-mountain becoming a flame-form, on another surrounding peak becoming a wisdom-form-filled, on another spoken peak becoming a dual hue, granting the three principles for the spoken fivefold elements, as an ecstasy-form without beginning, middle, or end, dancing in the Ampalam—the greatness of the pair of feet, neither Vediyan, Thirumal, nor Rudra knows. Knowing not the outcome, can I know? Tell me, my friend.
arutpa:T375:3: Though the dance-lord who desired is your lord indeed, yet when you see other revered leaders, you say, 'Why walk the streets in pride without speaking a good word to those who marveled?' Oh friend! Is this universe and beyond merely the mountain of nada, or are not those great ones beyond it also my kindred? I am a bonded citizen knowing only the servitude to the feet that dance their eternal dance in Chitrambalam.
arutpa:T375:13: If mouth-shut silence is indeed that, oh friend, the seven outer spaces of the silence-shakti cease in the Supreme of the Supreme. If that is the pure Paraparam itself, behold, it melts and blends right into the shining middle space. If you say middle space, it pervades the Tatpara space. If you say Tatpara space, it too is contained within that vast space. This alone is the measure; to measure beyond this is hard, truly hard.
arutpa:T257:26: All sorrows ended, bliss bore fruit, surrounding you grace-light filled, the experience of pure Sannarga state is yours freely, removing all harshness in the world, making all good paths, gaining all true life, that all living beings may rejoice, you desired it. According to your mind's thought, may you receive love, play undying through aeons, we have given you the rule of grace-light, we will not forsake you, we will not forsake you, our oath, our oath—thus joyfully speaking divine words and blending within me, the Guru who stayed in tune, the all-doing miraculous siddha, Nataraja shining in the jeweled hall.
arutpa:T257:29: All the sweet words spoken by those in the enduring world are our long words indeed. This is the truth, my son, fear not at all in your heart. We have granted you the dancing Arutperumjothi; standing in the undying state, live and play everywhere by love as you thought—the Guru who gave experiential wisdom in the central search when I was young, oh father, mother, friend, helper, unbreakable sweet joy within me, love, the one, the formless, becoming surging nectar upon the peak of a river, the rising Nataraja.
arutpa:T258:8: Saying singly to me, 'This, this is the state of Tat Tvam Asi, behold, this is the truth,' removing all proud bendings, raising me to the true state, granting an undying nature through grace, making siddhis come and dance throughout all worlds—oh great grace-Siva-supreme flame, ocean of grace giving the righteous path, sole-dancing Nataraja, my true guru gem.
arutpa:T360:26: Vast, true Vedas endless, Agamas declaring an endless stream beyond, Siva whom even searching through the clarifying great space and limitless time one sees not, Vallal who removed great bewildered enmity and made me yours, clear nectar, Arutperumjothi, king of the Ampalam, mother, father, sanctuary.
arutpa:T347:48: You showed me well the dance of the elemental space, the sport of the regional space, the play in the bliss space, the dance within the yoga space, the curvet in the nada space, and the supreme nada dance, along with an unfailing steadfastness, for both you and me.
arutpa:T347:50: Oh supreme yogi, sole chieftain ruling as a flame-form within the great space of grace, holy lord who took me into your heart as substance, praised lord, lotus-footed one dancing at the end of nada, for both you and me.
arutpa:T347:54: Father, who is like me who reached you? Gods declare I reached the state transcending the thirty-six. Even when this earthly and other elements dissolve, I will live praising and rejoicing in you; is there any doubt of this for you and me?
arutpa:T347:57: Surpassing the nada space of vindu, it extends yet further; transcending the upper space too, the command of your devotees rules. Alas, not a soul knows your greatness even a little; if they knew, they would melt and swiftly become the form of bliss, for both you and me.
arutpa:T347:96: Flame appearing everywhere standing amidst the pure state, flame shining even beyond the turiya space, divine flame glowing and rising in the hearts of siddhas, flame excelling within me dancing in Chitrambalam, for both you and me.
arutpa:T347:101: Praise to the justice-flame of pure siva-sannarga! Praise to the Chitrambalam flame that grants blissful life! Praise to the flame dancing in the pure radiant golden hall! Praise to the flame shining so that all light glows!
arutpa:T305:76: Beyond the space of single supreme yoga, O you who stood as the single space, come! O unique yet manifold ones, come! Come!
arutpa:T313:31: The medicine that is space within space — the medicine shining having transcended all spaces; the medicine that is light within light — the true medicine that itself became all lights.
arutpa:T313:34: The medicine that removes the five impurities — the medicine that nourishes earth and the vast sky worlds; the medicine that grants abundant grace — the country's medicine that ruling myself becomes myself.
arutpa:T315:22: From the unblemished sky down to the earth — all ambrosia is just a tiny particle compared to this. Behold this, which is pure ambrosia: the dancing divine light in the sacred Chidambaram.
arutpa:T302:22: Behold, the Lord who possesses the government, who expanded all worlds and grants the five actions, is here in the hall. Do not fear!
arutpa:T303:15: The golden foot residing even within the six paths; the foot that is both beginning and beginningless; the foot that is my life's source with no end or limit; the foot that manifested as the five elements starting with earth.
arutpa:T348:14: O cause of all arts and worlds and creatures, O supreme and complete one with form, of the Shiva-cosmos.
arutpa:T377:11: I saw and rejoiced at the bodily color of the bridegroom performing brilliant dance in the middle of the eternal sacred assembly. O friend, how shall I speak of the manner in which this sacred form existed? The sun and moon shine, the fire flashes along with them, all joined as one—how can I utter the way countless crores shine? Even if spoken, it is not enough. That very form—even the conclusion of the Vedas finds it hard to describe. Alas, who can speak of the color of that rare, great light?
